text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for Эйсин Флэш's debut. I
expected
her to be more nervous, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The race begins in thirty minutes, so let's
take the
time to complete our final
checks.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You don't seem scared at all.

text_block_list.text: There is no reason to be scared.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I have been training methodically with
you for
this very day, after all.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
All that remains is to follow through with
our plan.
Am I wrong?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She's right, but there are a lot of racers
who are
unable to keep their emotions
at bay and become
overwhelmed in such
situations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I cannot see why. I'm only doing what is
expected.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The race is starting in twenty-five
minutes. I'll be
off now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
